designationHistory.indexText: Eufaula National Wildlife Refuge on the Chattahoochee River was established when the Department of the Army signed a permit giving the Interior Department use of land acquired for the Walter F. George Reservoir.

authority.citation: Secretarial permit from the Department of the Army (Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act)

designationHistory.note: Both FWS: the web page gives October 6, 1964; the CCP gives 1964. No non-FWS source found.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Eufaula NWR 'About Us' page
